name: com.fabianghe.game-protection-kit
description: Protects Unity games from theft: encrypts AssetBundles/Addressables with keys kept on your own server (Steam and Play Integrity entitlement), detects re-uploaded, re-signed and rehosted copies, enforces safer builds (IL2CPP, no leaked content or symbols), embeds an ownership canary that survives asset ripping, and scans suspected clones for evidence. One-click setup. No DRM: never blocks legit players, sends no data by default.

samples.description: Sends integrity signals to Firebase Analytics. Requires the Firebase Analytics SDK.
Replace the default stolen-copy notice with your own UI, wired in the Inspector.
Template for writing and registering your own integrity check.
Android entitlement proof for Content Lock Remote mode. Requires the Google Play Integrity plugin.
